description: Pydantic's default: inputs with an unambiguous conversion are converted (`"42"` to `42`, `"yes"` to `True`, `3` to `3.0`).
Only the exact type is accepted, except `int` for `float`; enabled per call, per model (`ConfigDict(strict=True)`) or per field.
Field types that stay strict inside a lax model; shorthand for `Annotated[bool, Strict()]`.
Lax reports text it could not parse as a number; strict reports an input that is not an `int` at all.
A subclass's `model_config` is merged with its parent's, so `strict=True` can be added while keeping `extra="forbid"`.
